text:
Marie: Hey team — prepping for ACME's premium deal call tomorrow. Need one clear POC checklist and success criteria we can commit to. Quick sync?
David: I can do a short runbook. Main asks from ACME: streaming chat, single-tenant data isolation, SSO/KMS, and predictable cost.
Samir: For streaming + low latency we should recommend Dedicated or Private. Hosted can work but latency variability might bite. p95 latency target?
Marie: They asked for p95 < 200ms for short responses (<128 tokens) and < 500ms for longer streaming chunks. Also want 99.9% availability window for working hours.
Emily: Ok to validate on Dedicated with a small reserved pool. For POC we can spin up 2x A100-equivalent workers, enable continuous batching and prefix cache.
David: Planned evals: 1) functional prompts set (50 prompts) 2) load test (concurrent 50 streams) 3) cost run (estimate tokens/day) 4) security attestation (questionnaire answers).
Marie: Success criteria check: all 50 prompts match expected quality thresholds (BLEU-like pass rate they provided), p95 latency hits target under the 50-stream load, and no secrets leave their VPC during tests. If any fail, we provide mitigation plan.
Olga: For security questionnaire: they'll need KMS integration, audit logs, and ACL mapping. We can provide a redacted network diagram and answer on key rotation cadence. Also confirm we support customer-managed keys in Private deployment.
David: Auth + SDK plan: use API key for Hosted; for Private/Dedicated we'll use mutual TLS + JWT for service accounts. Example header for Hosted: `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>` — note we should recommend short-lived keys for the POC.
Emily: SDK note: sample Node snippet for streaming
```
const r = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-base-1', input: '...'});
r.on('data', chunk => console.log(chunk));
```
We should give them an example with automatic reconnect and idempotency token.
Samir: Rate limits/quotas: POC baseline = 10k tokens/sec across the pool, burst to 20k for 60s. We'll surface `x-rate-limit-remaining` and `x-rate-limit-reset` headers. Recommend client-side exponential backoff: `retry_after = base * 2^attempt + jitter` up to 8s.
Marie: Pricing Qs: they asked about committed discount tiers and overage billing for Dedicated. Can finance provide the 6-month promo tier we discussed?
David: I'll loop in finance after this thread. For the POC quote I'll include an estimated cost bucket: infra + tokens + support. We should show a per-session token estimate so they can sanity-check.
Olga: Also ask them to fill out the security questionnaire before we start. I can pre-fill most items and mark the ones needing legal sign-off.
Marie: Can someone own the deploy/observability side during the POC? They want tracing and per-route cost telemetry.
Emily: I'll instrument the POC with console dashboards, trace hooks, and a sample alert on error_rate > 1%. I can provide time-series screenshots by day 2.
Samir: Failover plan: if Dedicated capacity drops, auto-route to a lower-capacity hosted model variant with an explicit degradation notice. We'll test this by simulating node loss during load test.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: `poc-acme/dedicated-pool-v1` — expected start in ~45m. :gear:
Marie: Great. Action items: @David draft POC runbook + pricing estimate by EOD, @Emily instrument dashboards + example SDK samples by tomorrow a.m., @Olga finalize security questionnaire answers and send to ACME legal. Samir, can you validate rate limits and retry guidance?
Samir: Yep — I'll run a short load test and post results in this thread when done.
David: I'll also prepare a short one-pager with the success criteria and rollback policy for the kickoff.
Marie: Thanks everyone. I'll present this aligned checklist in the kickoff call. :thumbsup:
